# Snapshot a real project slice privately and scrub it
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #121, sha256:3b8377fe7aa3d04b6732019d67f5dd1d732fdf3ca07f167b406ae7bcfecb77d8). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Superseded 2026-10-27 by cards 125 and 126 (Decider D84): The product owner dropped the private projects in favour of a public repository
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** data (thin slice; a private snapshot, needs Dispatch go-ahead)
- **Milestone:** Codebase size: does Phrase's cost fall and its edge widen as the codebase grows?
- **Source:** Product direction, 2026-10-27 (test against different code base sizes; use real projects as the medium and large codebases) and Decider D82 (Codex, Grok Support-it; Copilot Yes). A separate question beside the frozen bar (D32); no frozen number changes and no stored row is re-scored.
- **Depends on:** 120
- **Story:** As Steve, I want a representative slice of one of my real projects copied read-only into a private folder and scrubbed, so that the experiment can use real code without anything leaving my machine except totals.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given Dispatch has confirmed in chat the exact source folder and the slice (one module or bounded context) and accepted that the scrubbed slice goes to the model CLIs, When the facilitator copies it, Then only source files of that slice are copied (no git history, databases, logs, secret files or build output), the source folder is not modified and nothing is run there
  2. Given the copy, When the scrub runs, Then an automated scan plus a recorded manual check remove connection strings, keys, production endpoints and user data, a scrub manifest lists what class of item was removed (not the values), and a check fails if the scan finds a secret pattern
  3. Given the public repository, When the tracked-file check of card 113 runs, Then it fails if any path under the private folder or any name from the project appears in a tracked file

## Context

- REAL-PROJECT RULES (binding, D82): read-only (never modify, commit, branch or run anything in the source project; take a snapshot copy only, by the facilitator, only after Dispatch confirms the exact source folder in chat); the copy is source files only (no git history, databases, logs or secret files) in a git-ignored folder like the holdouts; secrets (connection strings, keys, production endpoints, user data) are scrubbed before any author reads it, by an automated scan plus a manual check recorded in a scrub manifest; Dispatch accepts in chat that the scrubbed slice is sent to the model CLIs (external providers); nothing from the project (code, data, names, paths, prompts, replies) is ever committed; only totals are published; rows go to private results (cards 113 and 114); a retention rule deletes the copy when the experiment ends.
